summary: Frontend-only test of the floating '?' help button (HelpButton.jsx). Working: help-btn shows on every layout page for admin, contabile and operatore and is absent on /guida. All 19 route mappings are correct: help-sheet-title 'Aiuto · <chapter>' and the matching guida-cap-{id} inside the sheet (TD04 -> Note di credito, prima-nota and impostazioni -> Primi passi). In /fatture/nuova the typed causale and date are kept after closing the panel with Esc and with X. help-open-guida closes the sheet, goes to /guida#ddt and scrolls the DDT chapter to top 15px; the body is not left locked. Print media hides the button. Mobile sheet is full width (390x844) with no horizontal overflow. On desktop 1920 the button covers no controls on 8 pages. One minor overlap on mobile.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px, scrolled to the very bottom, the fixed button (x 326-370, y 780-824) still covers the bottom-right corner of save-invoice-btn (41-349 x 759-795) in /fatture/nuova and of ddt-note-input in /ddt/nuovo. The button stays clickable at its centre. Cause: the page has no bottom padding to make room for the floating button.

action_items: Add bottom padding on mobile, e.g. pb-20 on <main> in Layout.jsx (or lg:pb-0), so the last controls of editors are not under the floating '?' button.
critical_code_review_comments: HelpButton keeps its open state across route changes (browser back/forward while open just swaps the chapter). This is harmless; it could close on pathname change if you prefer.

The 'Primi passi' chapter, now the fallback for every unmapped page including admin-only ones such as /impostazioni, includes 'Il tuo ruolo di operatore'. This text is shown to admins too (this content predates this change).

success_rate.frontend: 97% (all functional checks pass; 1 minor mobile overlap)
